zh-Hans: 本机 xnux status 的健康度与控制台一致：有未结束的 P0 事件时，分数封顶 20；根分区写作“根分区”
装有 cosign 时，安装和升级脚本只接受本仓库发版流程签发的签名；GitHub 上的版本缺少签名时不会安装
en: The local xnux status scores health as the console does: an unresolved P0 event caps the score at 20, and / reads Root (/)
With cosign installed, the install and upgrade script accepts only signatures made by this repository's release workflow, and does not install a GitHub release that has none
